name: Stick
description: A dry branch, useful for torches or a rough blade.

name: Rope
description: Coiled cord. Good for binding or climbing.

name: Flint
description: A sharp stone for striking sparks.

name: Bone
description: A small bone, hard and useful for tools or needles.

name: Spider Silk
description: Sticky strands from dungeon spiders. Burns slowly; good for wicks and wraps.

name: Iron Shard
description: A jagged scrap of metal, perhaps from a broken weapon or trap.

name: Wooden Sword
description: A crude blade of bound sticks. Better than bare hands.

name: Torch
description: A stick wrapped in spider silk, ready to light.

name: Fire Starter
description: Flint, stick, and silk — everything needed to make fire.

name: Bone Needle
description: A sharpened bone with an eye of spider silk.
